Customize Bayesian GMST Reconstruction Parameters




To create a Bayesian global mean surface temperature (BayGMST) reconstruction, adjust the options below or keep the published defaults. BayGMST fits a Bayesian hierarchical model (STAN) to reduced proxy predictors derived from your selected PAGES 2k records, calibrated against the instrumental record. Choose the proxy type and reduced-proxy method, the reconstruction window, the Stan sampler controls, and the CO2/volcanic forcing transforms.







Included in the name of the GitHub repository created for this run.


? Which proxy archive types to include. "ALL_cached_Barboza" uses the cached reduced proxies baked into the image and ignores your LiPDverse query.





? Method used to compute the reduced proxy predictors. SIR is still under construction upstream.







? Number of Stan warmup (burn-in) iterations per chain.



? Number of Stan sampling iterations per chain (must be at least 1000).



? Number of Stan MCMC chains.



? Number of chains to run in parallel.





? First year of the full reconstruction window (years CE).



? First year of the instrumental period; earlier years are treated as missing.



? Final year of the full reconstruction window (years CE).





? Preindustrial CO2 reference concentration for the forcing transform G = co2_coef * log(CO2 / c0).



? Scaling coefficient in the CO2 forcing transform.





? Scaling coefficient in the volcanic forcing transform V = -|vol_coef| * (1 - exp(-V)).
